nodes.summary: The hypothesis CR₃^Inf is the following assertion. Let $d$ be a squarefree positive integer with $d\equiv5\pmod8$. Suppose that the 2-Selmer group $\mathrm{Sel}_2(C_d)$ has exactly $8$ elements and contains a pair $(a,b)$ with $|a|\equiv7\pmod8$. Then $y^2=x^3-d^2x$ has infinitely many rational solutions $(x,y)\in\mathbb Q^2$.
